name: Euc Idocrase
original_name: ユーク・アイドクレーズ
source:
Star Sign: Leo
Lapis's third oldest brother. Lase's twin.

A promising royal knight who specializes in combat magic. He skipped a grade to graduate early.
He wants to be kind to his little sister but he doesn't know how, so he's always doing strange things.
